2: func fib(n)
  2: block
    3: if (n < 2)
      3: block
        4: return n
    6: return (fib((n - 1)) + fib((n - 2)))
9: var(const) nums = array[5, 3, 8, 1]
10: var(let) total = 0
11: for [var(let) i = 0] [(i < nums.length)] [(i++)]
  11: block
    12: expr (total += nums[i])
14: expr console.log("total", total)
16: foreach(of const) x in nums
  16: block
    17: if (x > 4)
      17: block
        18: expr console.log(x, "besar")
      else
      19: if (x > 2)
        19: block
          20: expr console.log(x, "sedang")
        else
        21: block
          22: expr console.log(x, "kecil")
26: var(let) k = 3
27: while (k > 0)
  27: block
    28: expr (k--)
31: do-while (k < 2)
  31: block
    32: expr (k++)
35: switch k
  36: case 1
    37: expr console.log("satu")
    38: break 
  39: case 2
    40: expr console.log("dua")
    41: break 
  42: default
    43: expr console.log("lain")
46: var(const) person = object{name: "Ani", age: 20}
47: foreach(in const) key in person
  47: block
    48: expr console.log(`${key} = ${person[key]}`)
50: expr console.log(fib(6))
